about: The `namelist` of a <send> names variables the machine holds, each carried as the pair `<param name="x" expr="x"/>` it abbreviates and read when the send runs: `send.names` sends `view.shown` with `layout` (an enum value, crossing as the name its enum declares) and `zoom` (an integer), and the machine reads them back through the schema. `agenda_list` is spelled with an underscore: the wire carries the name the document wrote. `send.mixed` writes `layout` in the namelist and `zoom + 1` in a <param>: the pairs of both go in the one event. Expected values are derived from the document, not observed from a backend.

steps.note: the names cross as the values the variables hold
the variables change; nothing is sent
the values are read when the send runs: the underscore name crosses as written
a name of the namelist and a computed param make one event
